MY.title: “We met at a party through friends. Everyone else was drinking and dancing, but we just sat in the corner, talking for hours. Eight months later, I got a European train pass and asked her to come travel with me. We camped wherever we could, sleeping in the wild bushes of Germany, a stranger’s garden in Belgium, and waking up to the sunrise by the sea in Italy. Traveling like that is a true test. There are hard moments when you're hungry, tired, and have nowhere to sleep, but you completely forget those parts when you're with the right person. Now we’re trying to figure out what comes next. I want to study abroad in Denmark, and Zsuzsi wants to stay in Hungary. It feels like an impossible choice between love and the life you imagined. We don't know yet how it works out, but we have a few more months to figure it out.” — Zoárd & Zsuzsi Budapest, Hungary Life on Film #lifeonfilm
MY.author: Life on Film

BR.title: Nutella Brownies ✨🧸🍫 Brownie Layer: 110g butter (½ cup) 170g chocolate (1 cup) 200g sugar (1 cup) 2 eggs 80g flour (⅔ cup) 20g cocoa powder (3 tbsp) 1 tsp vanilla 45g chocolate chunks (¼ cup) ½ tsp salt Nutella (about 4–5 tbsp) Extra chocolate chunks Instructions: Melt the butter and chocolate together until smooth. Mix in the sugar, then add the eggs and vanilla. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until combined, then mix in the chocolate chunks. Pour half of the brownie batter into a lined baking pan and spread evenly. Add spoonfuls of Nutella in the middle, then cover with the remaining brownie batter. Top with extra chocolate chunks and bake at 175°C until the top is crackly and the center stays fudgy. Enjoy✨ #brownie #baking #chocolate #nutella #recipes

GLOBAL.title: “We met at a party through friends. Everyone else was drinking and dancing, but we just sat in the corner, talking for hours. Eight months later, I got a European train pass and asked her to come travel with me. We camped wherever we could, sleeping in the wild bushes of Germany, a stranger’s garden in Belgium, and waking up to the sunrise by the sea in Italy. Traveling like that is a true test. There are hard moments when you're hungry, tired, and have nowhere to sleep, but you completely forget those parts when you're with the right person. Now we’re trying to figure out what comes next. I want to study abroad in Denmark, and Zsuzsi wants to stay in Hungary. It feels like an impossible choice between love and the life you imagined. We don't know yet how it works out, but we have a few more months to figure it out.” — Zoárd & Zsuzsi Budapest, Hungary Life on Film #lifeonfilm

GLOBAL.title: Nutella Brownies ✨🧸🍫 Brownie Layer: 110g butter (½ cup) 170g chocolate (1 cup) 200g sugar (1 cup) 2 eggs 80g flour (⅔ cup) 20g cocoa powder (3 tbsp) 1 tsp vanilla 45g chocolate chunks (¼ cup) ½ tsp salt Nutella (about 4–5 tbsp) Extra chocolate chunks Instructions: Melt the butter and chocolate together until smooth. Mix in the sugar, then add the eggs and vanilla. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until combined, then mix in the chocolate chunks. Pour half of the brownie batter into a lined baking pan and spread evenly. Add spoonfuls of Nutella in the middle, then cover with the remaining brownie batter. Top with extra chocolate chunks and bake at 175°C until the top is crackly and the center stays fudgy. Enjoy✨ #brownie #baking #chocolate #nutella #recipes
